name: Bond market volatility
summary: Treasury volatility at the Watch line as yields hover near 5%
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility stood at 100 on 30 Oct, right on the Watch threshold, with the US 10-year yield at 4.93% after touching about 5.2% in mid-October. The Fed held on 28 Oct after a September hike, and markets price a December hike. No trading since 30 Oct.
for_you: Long-term borrowing costs, including US mortgage rates, are elevated and moving more than usual. This feeds through to global bond markets, including UK gilts.
rubric_hit: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — ICE BofA MOVE Index
investingLive — FOMC decision 28 Oct: rates left unchanged

why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
